annotation.authors_or_issuer: Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Provincia de Santa Fe
key_provisions_or_claims: Generative AI is only a support tool; judicial decisions remain exclusively with magistrates and officials.
Mandatory critical validation of all AI-generated content against reliable sources.
Prohibition on delegating decision-making to generative AI; human judgment must prevail.
Do not enter personal or confidential data into tools lacking adequate privacy protections; anonymise or pseudonymise first.
Continuous training on risks such as hallucinations, bias, opacity and overreliance.
annotation.summary_en: Good-practice guide annexed to Circular 25 (April 2025) of the Santa Fe Supreme Court (Argentina) on generative AI use in the judiciary. It treats AI as a support tool, requires validation of outputs, bans delegating decisions, requires human responsibility, personal data protection and anonymisation, and continuous training.
annotation.title_clean: Circular Nro. 25 (2025) — Guía de buenas prácticas para el uso de la inteligencia artificial generativa
annotation.title_en: Circular No. 25 (2025) — Guide of Good Practices for the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence
